verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs index lists first-party pages on 'Retroactively Assigning an External Entity ID', 'Multiple External Entity IDs' and 'Entity Merging', so the product does document stable external identifiers and reconciliation for customer (entity) records. The evidence is only page titles, though, and nothing ties external IDs to case or investigation records. Missing for 10: substantive docs on how external entity IDs are assigned and kept stable, external identifiers for case/investigation records, merge/reconciliation behavior details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
